usage: Noun; use 中提琴 when you mean the viola, a string instrument in the violin family.
It is a neutral, formal term and is common in music lessons, orchestras, and instrument listings.
You can use it after verbs like 拉 or 學, or with classifiers such as 一把中提琴.
Learners often mix it up with 小提琴 and 大提琴, so remember that 中提琴 refers to the middle-sized alto string instrument.
